review_kind: actual individual PNG and rendered-PDF raster inspection; not human review
review_scope: Legibility, axes, legend, complete series/parameters/design displays, truth/count annotations, source-consistent trends, qualification and raster/PDF layout. Numerical arithmetic has separate independent tests; this image review is not a model-correctness proof.
transfer_condition: Judgment may be transferred only when both PNG and PDF bytes exactly match the recorded hashes; the new package must name this original reviewer/time and identify the transfer.

notes: Individually inspected the native PNG and the actual rendered PDF page. All nine panels are present: nominal CV = 0, 1, 3 crossed with theta,mu,sigma; Exact,PFML,Euler are named and identifiable by color and line style.

Simulation truth lines, valid/planned counts 2000/2000, original-unit mu labels and cumulative-probability axes are legible. Visible tails reach the full ECDF range; no apparent axis cropping or omitted extreme series.

Regular exact/PFML curves coincide as expected; this is disclosed in the footer and their solid/dashed styles are visible. The regular mu curves also coincide. Descriptive/post-result-selection qualification and absence of confidence bands are stated.
At 1400-pixel PDF rendering the first-row mu tick labels are compact but distinguishable; no blocking overlap or clipping is visible.
Individually inspected native PNG and rendered PDF page. All 12 panels are present for CV = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1 and theta,mu,sigma, with all three estimator series, truth lines and 2000/2000 counts.

Complete lower-CV supplementary coverage complements the main presentation. The regular exact/PFML overlap is disclosed and distinguished by line style; mu curves remain close/coincident rather than being incorrectly separated.

Axis titles, tick labels, legend and footer are readable at the 1400-pixel PDF scale. The page is dense but has no cropped or overlapping panels. Count annotations lightly cover the lowest ECDF region; raw samples and full ECDF data remain available.
Individually inspected native PNG and rendered PDF page. All nine panels for CV = 1.5, 2, 3 and theta,mu,sigma include all three estimator series, truth lines and 2000/2000 counts.

The visible change in Euler sigma relative to PFML across CVs is retained rather than forced into a monotone story. Mu is labelled in original state units. Full observed-tail extents are visible with no apparent axis clipping.

PDF labels, legend, uncertainty-scope footer and post-result-presentation disclosure are legible at 1400 pixels. The generic regular-grid coincidence note refers to the complete F1 set even though this supplementary page contains only positive CVs; this is nonblocking.
Individually inspected native PNG and rendered PDF page. Both empirical-SD and RMS-reported-SE panels contain all 18 stochastic cell/method points: MMPP/IID at r = 1, 5, 20 and Exact,PFML,Euler.

Both panels visibly use identical y limits/ticks; markers and common legend are clear. r = 20 PFML empirical SD near 0.0354 under MMPP versus 0.0306 under IID, and RMS reported SE near 0.0309/0.0308, agree with independently checked saved quantities.

Header states exploratory E4, mu in original state units and 2,000 interval-valid fits per cell/method. Footer accurately identifies descriptive points with no new MC intervals and the same eligible subset, and retains the working-covariance limitation.

No blocking clipping, text overlap or missing series is visible in PNG or 1400-pixel PDF rendering. Axis shorthand MMPP at r = 20 relies on the accompanying full caption/protocol to state the declared floor and MMPP-derived source qualification.
